records.name: French Toast Bar
records.ingredients: Liquid Whole Eggs ((whole eggs, egg whites [98%], citric acid, water, natural flavor, sodium hexametaphosphate, guar gum, xanthan gum, color [includes beta carotene]. vitamins and minerals: calcium sulfate, vitamin a palmitate, iron [ferric orthophosphate], vitamin e [alpha-tocopherol acetate], vitamin d3, zinc sulfate, calcium pantothenate, vitamin b12, vitamin b1 [thiamine mononitrate], vitamin b6 [pyridoxine hydrochloride], vitamin b2 [riboflavin], folic acid.) ), 2% Milk (reduced fat milk, vitamin a palmitate and vitamin d3), Sliced Unsweetened Strawberries, Granulated Sugar, Frozen Blueberries, Imitation Vanilla Extract  (water, vanillin, caramel color, ethyl vanillin and 0.1% potassium sorbate [added as a preservative]), Ground Cinnamon, Ground Nutmeg, Sliced Texas Toast (unbleached, unbromated enriched wheat flour [malted barley flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate, riboflavin and folic acid], water, yeast, sugar, contains 2% or less of the following: salt, soybean oil, wheat gluten, sodium alginate, annatto extract & turmeric extract, calcium propionate, ascorbic acid, canola oil, guar gum, sunflower lecithin, wheat protein isolate, enzymes, monoglyerides [SESAME SEEDS USED INSIDE BAKERY])
